title: Mexican Crispy Chicken
description: A flavorful Mexican dish with crispy chicken, perfect for lunch or dinner. The combination of garlic and crispy texture makes it irresistible.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together the crushed tortilla chips and crumb.
Dip each chicken breast in the milk, then coat in the tortilla chip mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat about 1/4 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the chicken breasts until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, mix together the minced garlic and milk in a small bowl.
After the chicken has baked for 5 minutes, brush the garlic-milk mixture on top of the chicken.
Continue baking for the remaining 5 minutes.
